questions.q: What is the synchronous speed of a 4-pole, 50 Hz induction motor?
The same motor runs at 1440 rpm. What is the slip? Give a decimal.
For a centrifugal pump, load torque varies with speed as:
questions.explain: Fan and pump loads have torque proportional to speed squared.

questions.q: Speed control of a DC motor above base speed is done by:
questions.explain: Reducing $\phi$ raises speed in the constant power region.

questions.q: A 220 V DC motor has $R_a = 0.5\ \Omega$ and $K\phi = 1.2$ V·s/rad. Find the speed in rad/s at $I_a = 20$ A.
Which braking method returns energy to the supply?
questions.explain: In regenerative braking $E_b > V$ and power flows back to the source.

questions.q: Positive speed with negative torque is which quadrant?
Why is $V/f$ kept constant in variable-frequency control?
options: To raise the power factor to 1
questions.explain: Flux is proportional to $V/f$; keeping it constant avoids saturation and keeps torque capability.
